name: 120-r3sj-boundary-readback-paused
description: No latency, build from 12 (8.081 s appended). Paused at 12@~1.5 s: jump_to(13) sets currentTime 8.081, which Chrome reads back as 8.080999 (microsecond truncation), so the player reports 12 at its end. Then next must reach 14, and previous from 13@0 must reach 12.
